name: 王貞淑
objective:
金融科技是近年來新興的產業趨勢，影響的層面非常廣泛，不只是金融方面，更牽涉到新興科技與物聯網。本課程將從不同的角度分析金融科技的技術內容、應用領域及商業模式，並藉由國內外重要金融科技公司發展的經驗做一介紹，希望達到了解並運用此新興科技的目的。本課程內容包括：金融科技概論、金融科技商業模式、金融大數據、P2P 借貸、虛擬貨幣、雲端服務、第三方支付、群眾募資、區塊鏈、跨境電商、程式交易、機器人理財等主題。
FinTech includes two words: Finance and Technology. It is a new trend of industrial field. It has influences on lots of technical fields, not only finance, but also emerging technologies and IoT. This course will analyze FinTech from different angles, such as technology contents, application fields and business models. It also will utilize experiences of leading companies with FinTech to obtain decent knowledge of this new field. The contents of this course include introduction to financial technology, business models of financial technology, finance big data, P2P lending, virtual money, cloud services, third-party payment, crowd funding, blockchain, cross-border e-commerce, program trading, and robotic financial advisory etc.
schedule:
Weekly Schedule and Course Outline
Week 1: Course Overview
    Introduction to Deep Learning and AI Tools
    Introduction to Design Thinking
    Design Thinking and Project Development Process
    Explanation of Course Grading Rubric
Week 2: Data Processing and the KDD Process
    Overview of the KDD Process
    Data Processing with Pandas/NumPy
    Feature Engineering
Week 3: Financial Data Analysis and Credit Risk Models
    Credit Risk Assessment Using Kaggle Datasets
Week 4: Fundamentals of Deep Learning
    Building Simple Neural Networks with Keras/TensorFlow
    Impact of Hyperparameter Tuning
Week 5: Stock Price Prediction Model Development
    Training and Predicting with Historical Data
    Gradient Descent Method
Week 6: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) - Theory and Applications
    Basic Structure and Implementation of CNN: LeNet, VGG
Week 7: Application of CNN in Credit Card Fraud Detection
    Training Fraud Detection Models Using Kaggle Datasets
    Discussion on Model Accuracy and Overfitting Issues
Week 8: Guest Lecture on AI Applications in Finance
    Expert Sharing Case Studies
    Focus on AI Applications in Financial Risk Control to Inspire Project Design
Week 9: Project Progress Report and Discussion
    Group Presentations: 
    Data Sources, Model Strategies, Expected Contributions
Week 10: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and LSTM
    Time Series Data Analysis: Applications of RNN and LSTM
Week 11: Application of LSTM in Stock Price Prediction
    Training LSTM Models for Stock Price Forecasting
Week 12: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
    Structure and Applications of GANs: Data Augmentation, 
    Financial Market Simulation
    Practical Implementation with PyTorch Model Building
Week 13: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DQN)
    Design and Implementation of Deep Q-Networks (DQN)
    Software Implementation and Strategy Design
Week 14: Model Export and Deployment
    Cloud Deployment Using TensorFlow Serving
Week 15: Summary and Cross-Domain Applications
    Review and Discussion on Cross-Domain Applications of Deep Learning
Week 16: Internal Final Project Presentation
    Preparation of Final Project Data and Model Design
Week 17: External Final Project Presentation
    Presentation of Project Outcomes and Peer Evaluation
Week 18: Course Reflection and Summary
    Reflection on the Course and Discussion on Future Applications
